minutes.summary: The board heard public comment mostly about a disputed water district vote, approved the Salvation Army boot drive and an alteration of premises for Il Forno, and received a police accreditation presentation. what_happened.line: The Select Board granted an alteration of premises for Il Forno's alcohol license, provided the building does not substantially stray from the plans shown.
The town manager reported that the state certified free cash for the general fund and the enterprise funds.
The board voted 5-0 to put four articles on the consent calendar for the Nov 15 special town meeting.
The board approved a Salvation Army toll booth fundraiser and ratified the appointment of a tax collector principal clerk.
The board deferred its discussion of criteria for ARPA requests to next week, aiming to finalize them before year end.

why_it_matters: Free cash certification and the special town meeting articles set what voters will be asked to appropriate on Nov 15, including the funding to cover the first-year cost of the new police contract.
The ARPA criteria, still unsettled, will decide how the remaining federal relief money is requested and awarded.
watch_next: The ARPA request criteria return to the Select Board agenda next week.
The special town meeting is on Nov 15; articles on the consent calendar are voted together.
